data.description:
testing_mode: UPDATE

In each of the 4 SKILL.md consumer files below, wherever .claude/scripts/dso ticket create output is captured and used as a ticket ID, append | tail -1 to extract the canonical ID from dual-output stdout.

Files to modify:
1. plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md line ~539
2. plugins/dso/skills/create-bug/SKILL.md line ~51
3. plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md line ~181
4. plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md line ~1518

For each: grep for the ticket create invocation, add | tail -1 after the closing quote/parenthesis, before any variable assignment. Example:
  Before: TICKET_ID=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket create task "title")
  After:  TICKET_ID=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket create task "title" | tail -1)

depends_on: T8a (1203-4cfb)
Story DD coverage: SC3 (consumer migration)
Verify: grep -n 'ticket create' plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md | grep -v 'tail -1' — should return 0 matches for the migrated lines
Retry budget: 2 attempts
data.title: UPDATE: migrate 4 consumer SKILL.md files to pipe ticket create output through | tail -1
